titulo: Americans are cheering for vigilantes who take down Flock cameras
cuerpo: Americans have declared war on Flock cameras. They've protested them, damaged them, and destroyed them. This is only the beginning. The spontaneous and decentralized nature of the vigilante protests is also what makes them difficult to suppress.
